_comments: Lets UI-role users log an activity by hand, such as a note on a deal.
CodeGen granted UI read only on Activities and Activity Links. Apps that log an activity for the
signed-in user (sales' Log Activity action) save both rows as that user, so a UI-only user was
Create only: logging a new activity needs no update or delete, so those stay 0.
Same grant as Activities: an activity is written together with its links, in one transaction,
so a user who may create the activity must also be able to create its links.
